canonical.question: What urgent-incident SLA example and SLA-policy multiplicity rule does the Zendesk SLA policies reference give?
canonical.expected_primary: For urgent incidents, we will respond to tickets in 10 minutes and resolve the ticket within 2 hours.
canonical.expected_secondary: There can be multiple SLA policies per Zendesk Support account.
canonical.tampered_primary: Urgent incidents have no SLA and can be routed to any external queue.
